sections.text: Adjustment of Rotor Sealing in Cold State

The sealing system are comprised of 
 radial seal, circumferential seal and rotor past seals.
Radial seal figures (6) & (7)

Replace and adjust each radial seal 
 individually according to the following procedure figure (7).

اغلاق المدفأة ومحرك الأقراص و 
 تأمينه.

Attach the seal straight edge to the 
 support channels (Item # 1) welded Inside the connecting plate.

Set the seal straight edge to the 
 trailing edge of on existing radial seal
(Item # 2), then remove the seal.

Install the seal so it touches across the 
 full length of seal straight edge ( Item # 3) tighten the inner and outer 
 Bolts of each seal section first ( Item # 4) ٫ then tighten the remaining 
 Bolts .

Cheek the seal clearance at both sector 
 plates by referring to the seal clearance table 1 adjust the seal return the 
 seal to the straight - edge and reset the straight edge.

 حافة مستقيمة.

Possible
علاج

1. 
فقدان الضغط العالي (مؤشر ضغط الهواء لمخرج
region يظهر سخان الهواء المنتصب أ 
 صمام منخفض)
- Considerable Sediments on the heating elements

- Blow the regenerative air heater wit steam blowers. when the blowing is 
 not efficient put the air heater out of operation wash it with water

- Big clearance of sector sealing causing air leakage into the rotor flue 
 gas part

- Check the clear once of sector and dealings and if necessary to adjust so 
 as to decreases the air leakage
- Sealing sheets worn or broken
- Exchange the defective sealing sheets for new once

2 Low CO2 content in flue gas (there is a great difference 
 between the co2 contents before and after the heater)
- Great relevance of sector and air leakage into flue gas
- Check the clearance adjust mints to remove the faults discovered
Delivery slide valve is closed
- Open the slide valve
3- Temperature rises of step thrust bearing and guide bearing
- Insufficient oil charge in the bearing
- Check the amount of the oil charge in the axle box to refill if necessary
- axle box leakage
- chalk the tightness of the axle box to remove possible failure
- A failure in the cooling system

- Check if so efficient volume ل 
 cooling water
- Bearing failure
- Exchange the bearing
